name: Shane Cancilla
biography: Shane Cancilla is the Network Engineer for the 2003 Cyber Protection Team in Alameda, CA, focused on building and integrating tools for assessment, incident response, and threat hunting missions across Marine Transportation System and IT/OT/ICS environments. His work spans the engineering and deployment of sensors across complex networks and supporting mission-critical operations as a network analyst. He has previously worked with organizations including Lawrence Livermore and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratories, where he supported high performance computing and virtualized network environments. Shane holds a B.S. in Computer Science from California State University, East Bay, along with CCNA and GCIH certifications.
